probable_root_cause: The source dataset may contain a wide variety of distinct clinical or administrative codes, some of which cannot be associated with valid standard concept mappings. This can occur with source-specific diagnosis or procedure codes, drug codes, or uncommon clinical values that are not covered by the available OMOP vocabulary or implemented mapping rules. Consequently, these distinct source values may have a corresponding standard Concept ID of 0, resulting in failure of this check when the unmapped proportion exceeds the configured threshold. A large number of uncommon unmapped codes can contribute to the failure even when frequently occurring codes are mapped successfully.
